title: Fix dashboard heat map showing no data and My Songs empty
description: The heat map on the dashboard shows nothing - no activity data displayed. 'My Songs' section also remains empty even after practicing songs. These features appear to not be wired up to actual data.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Heat map shows activity for days with practice
Heat map intensity reflects amount of practice that day
My Songs shows songs user has practiced or wishlisted
Verify practiceLog data is being queried correctly
